title: Modules: import and export
summary: Split code across files and share it between them.
heading: Modules: import and export

blocks.text: Real apps are too big for one file. Modules let you split your code into separate files and share pieces between them. You export what a file offers, and import what you need elsewhere.
Put export in front of anything you want other files to be able to use.

blocks.label: math.js

blocks.text: In another file, import the names you need and use them.

blocks.label: app.js

blocks.text: Every Angular file starts this way. import { Component } from '@angular/core'; is exactly this — pulling in code from another module.

items: Modules split your code across many files.
Angular files import the tools they need at the top.
